summary: The migration moves legacy-orders-app from Java 8/Spring Boot 1.5 to Java 17/Spring Boot 3.2, starting with shared foundational code and progressing through dependent services in dependency order. Each module requires remediation of deprecated APIs, javax-to-jakarta namespace changes, and framework-specific upgrades before moving to the next.

modules.riskReason: Small shared module but widely used; deprecated Date/Calendar usage is low complexity to fix
tasks: Replace Date and Calendar usage with java.time APIs
Upgrade to Java 17 syntax and build config
Update Maven dependencies to Spring Boot 3.2 compatible versions
Add unit tests for refactored utility classes

modules.riskReason: javax to jakarta namespace migration plus Spring Security config overhaul increases risk
tasks: Rewrite Spring Security configuration using Spring Security 6 model
Update REST controllers and DTOs for Spring Boot 3.2 compatibility
Run regression tests against customer profile APIs

modules.riskReason: Largest and most complex module; XML bean config and Hibernate 4 queries require significant rework alongside payment flow criticality
tasks: Convert XML-based bean configuration to Java/annotation-based config
Upgrade Hibernate 4 queries and mappings to Hibernate 6
Validate order creation and payment flow with integration tests
Performance test critical payment paths post-migration

modules.riskReason: Removed JAXB APIs require replacement libraries and careful validation of report output
tasks: Replace removed JAXB APIs with jakarta.xml.bind or alternative library
Update XML marshalling/unmarshalling logic and dependencies
Verify nightly sales report output matches legacy format
Update scheduled job configuration for Spring Boot 3.2
